Copper alloy Coin. Radiate fragment of Carausius (286-293), Reece period 14. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [ ] CARAVSIVS { ]. Reverse description: Pax standing left holding branch and vertical sceptre. Reverse inscription: PA[X AV]G; mintmark F O//ML. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin.
